hc_signedIn: Signed in to Home Connect — live updates connected.
hc_signInPrompt: Sign in to Home Connect: open the page below and confirm the code shown there.
hc_signInWaiting: No sign-in link right now. Enter your Client ID and Client Secret above and save — if they are saved already, request a new sign-in link.
hc_signedInNoStream: Signed in — but live updates are not connected right now. The adapter keeps retrying; use the test below to see why.
hc_notRunning: The adapter instance is not running — start it to test the connection.
hc_codeLabel: Code to confirm on the sign-in page:
hc_resetConfirm: Forget the current login and sign in again — for example with another Home Connect account?
hc_problem_clientId: Home Connect does not know this Client ID — copy it again from the developer portal (64 characters).
hc_problem_notActive: Home Connect does not accept the application (yet). A new or edited application takes 15 to 60 minutes to become active, and its status must be Enabled — then request a new sign-in link.
hc_problem_wrongFlow: The application was created with another OAuth flow. Register a new one with the OAuth flow “Device Flow” — it cannot be changed afterwards.
hc_problem_clientSecret: Home Connect rejected the Client Secret — check it above.
hc_problem_account: Home Connect refused this account. Check that it works in the Home Connect app (SingleKey ID, accepted terms of use) and that it is the account entered in the developer portal.
hc_problem_codeExpired: The sign-in code expired before it was confirmed — request a new sign-in link.
hc_problem_loginRevoked: The stored login is no longer valid — sign in again.
hc_problem_scope: The application may not use the requested permissions — check it in the developer portal.
hc_problem_other: Home Connect refused the sign-in — check the Client ID and Client Secret above.
hc_appSignInNeeded: Sign-in needed: open the sign-in page and sign in with the account of your Home Connect app.
hc_appSignInSteps: Sign in on the page that opened, with the account of your Home Connect app (open it again with the button if needed). The browser then ends on a Home Connect page that may show a QR code — ignore it, copy the full address from the browser's address bar and paste it below.
hc_appPasteLabel: Address of the page the sign-in ended on
hc_appProblem: Home Connect refused the sign-in — open the sign-in page and sign in again.
